strategy_roster.name: IBS Internal Bar Strength
strategy_roster.notes: The current bar's close location within its range approximates previous-bar IBS, retaining thresholds 0.09/0.985 and EMA(220). Re-entry spacing and the 14-bar maximum holding period require position state.

strategy_roster.name: Long-Only MTF EMA Cloud
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA 21/50 bullish crossover and 1%/2% protections are retained. The inverse crossover is a signal-exit proxy because the source otherwise exits only through protection.

strategy_roster.name: Color Schaff RSI Trend Cycle
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(23), the documented fast length, is an explicit proxy for the unavailable STC colors; crossing below 6 but not 2 maps the long transition. The 50-cycle smoothing and 60/-60 settings are not separately representable.

strategy_roster.name: RSI + MACD Long-Only
strategy_roster.entry_long: (crossabove(rsi(close,14),50) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)) or (crossabove(macd(close,12,26),macd_signal(close,12,26,9)) and rsi(close,14) > 50)
strategy_roster.notes: Both documented long entry branches and the RSI/MACD exit logic are retained with 14 and 12/26/9 defaults. The optional EMA(200), oversold-window context, and optional protection are omitted; numeric default percentages are kept.

strategy_roster.name: MartinGale Scalping
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA 3/8 relationship and inverse exit are direct. Pyramiding, slow-SMA price exits, and the 1.03/0.95 absolute levels are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Pipso Range Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: The long side uses a break below the prior 36-bar low and exits on the opposite channel high. Session hours and the 300% channel-derived stop require clock and entry-state fields.

strategy_roster.name: Darvas Boxes System
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 20-bar Donchian highs/lows exactly proxy the box boundaries and opposite exits. The 1000/2000 point protections are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Re Open Positions
strategy_roster.notes: Five-bar positive ROC is a one-percent fallback for reopening from the last entry because no threshold is supplied. Multi-position counting and per-entry point stops/targets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Arrows and Curves
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) is an explicit envelope fallback because the custom channel parameters have no defaults. The custom relay/state, pip stops, targets, and trailing cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Basic RSI EA Template
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing below the documented 30 level enters long, and a recross above 50 is a mean-reversion exit proxy. The 30/20 pip stop and target are not percentage exits.
